New Financial Rules Take Effect on August 1, Changes Affect Various Sectors

The Reserve Bank of India has introduced new rules for financial institutions, effective August 1. The changes include reduced LPG prices and simplified train ticket booking procedures. These modifications will impact various sectors, including banking, taxation, and credit card services.
